construct.zh: 人 OX2R · 4 处突变与截短 · 非融合构建
construct.en: Human OX2R · 4 mutations and truncations · non-fusion construct

copyNote.zh: 本条目为 OX2R 的单个受体–配体副本；可切换至 6TOT 查看 OX1R 复合物。
copyNote.en: This entry contains one OX2R–ligand copy; switch to 6TOT to inspect the OX1R complexes.

sourceSection.zh: 原始结构论文确立 7XRR 复合物；极性接触为本库依据原子类型与坐标计算的注释，不标记为原文逐条指认的氢键。
sourceSection.en: The primary structural study establishes the 7XRR complex. The polar-contact annotation is derived here from atom types and deposited coordinates, rather than labeled as an individually paper-assigned hydrogen bond.

explanation.zh: Gln134 羰基氧与药物酰胺 NH 的重原子接触，供体–受体类型相容。此处按坐标计算的极性接触展示，未进行氢键角度判定。
explanation.en: Heavy-atom proximity between the Gln134 carbonyl oxygen and ligand amide NH is donor–acceptor compatible. It is shown as a coordinate-derived polar contact; a hydrogen-bond angular criterion has not been evaluated.

readings.zh: 7XRR 的 Gln134 OE1–NRK N20 为 2.96 Å。与 Suvorexant 的 Asn324–羰基氢键不同，Lemborexant 的酰胺位于口袋另一侧。
readings.en: Gln134 OE1–NRK N20 is 2.96 Å in 7XRR. Unlike the Asn324–carbonyl anchor of Suvorexant, the Lemborexant amide faces another side of the pocket.

readings.zh: Asn324 的最近接触为 OD1–C11（3.63 Å），其中药物原子是碳。该连线仅表示重原子邻近。
readings.en: The nearest Asn324 contact is OD1–C11 (3.63 Å), involving a ligand carbon. This line denotes heavy-atom proximity only.

readings.zh: 与 OX1R 的实验结构对照
6TOT 提供 OX1R 的两个晶体副本，原始论文支持 Gln126 与 Ser103 的氢键。切换结构后，残基、原子对和距离均随所选坐标更新。
readings.en: 6TOT provides two OX1R crystal copies, with paper-assigned hydrogen bonds involving Gln126 and Ser103. Residues, atom pairs and distances update from the selected coordinates.

explanation.zh: Gln134 羰基氧与药物酰胺 NH 的重原子接触，供体–受体类型相容。此处按坐标计算的极性接触展示，未进行氢键角度判定。
explanation.en: Heavy-atom proximity between the Gln134 carbonyl oxygen and ligand amide NH is donor–acceptor compatible. It is shown as a coordinate-derived polar contact; a hydrogen-bond angular criterion has not been evaluated.

7XRR.receptorAltlocPolicy: common atoms plus alt A, if present

construct.zh: 人 OX1R · 稳定化突变与截短 · 非融合构建
construct.en: Human OX1R · stabilizing mutations and truncations · non-fusion construct

6TOT-A.citation: Rappas et al. · J Med Chem 2020

copyNote.zh: A、B 是同一晶体中的两个 OX1R 副本，不是不同受体亚型，也不代表不同亲和力。
copyNote.en: A and B are two OX1R copies in the same crystal, not different receptor subtypes or separate affinity measurements.

sourceSection.zh: 原始论文：结合模式结果章节与图 6；坐标来自对应 PDB 条目。
sourceSection.en: Primary paper: binding-mode Results section and Figure 6; coordinates from the corresponding PDB entry.

explanation.zh: 原始论文图 6 指认的 Gln126–药物酰胺羰基氢键；此处报告 N···O 重原子距离。
explanation.en: Gln126–ligand amide-carbonyl hydrogen bond assigned in Figure 6 of the original study; the value is the N···O heavy-atom distance.

explanation.zh: 原始论文图 6 指认的 Ser103–药物嘧啶氮氢键；此处报告 O···N 重原子距离。
explanation.en: Ser103–ligand pyrimidine-nitrogen hydrogen bond assigned in Figure 6; the value is the O···N heavy-atom distance.

readings.zh: Gln126 侧链与酰胺羰基 O19、Ser103 侧链与嘧啶 N15 构成原始论文描述的极性锚点。分别点击两处残基可检查具体原子对。
readings.en: Gln126 contacts the amide carbonyl O19 and Ser103 contacts pyrimidine N15, forming the polar anchors described in the original paper. Select either residue to inspect its atom pair.

readings.zh: 亚型对照需要保留原子身份
readings.en: Keep atom identity in subtype comparisons

readings.zh: OX1R 的 Gln126–O19 与 OX2R 的 Gln134–N20 涉及不同药物原子；不能仅按同源残基编号复制氢键。
readings.en: OX1R Gln126–O19 and OX2R Gln134–N20 involve different ligand atoms. Hydrogen-bond labels cannot be copied solely by matching homologous residue numbers.

readings.zh: 两个晶体副本分别计算
readings.en: Each crystal copy is calculated separately

readings.zh: A/B 副本的受体、配体和接触清单成对切换。不同副本间的距离变化不应被解释为药效或选择性差异。
readings.en: The receptor, ligand and contact list switch together between copies A and B. Differences in their distances should not be interpreted as differences in efficacy or selectivity.

explanation.zh: 原始论文图 6 指认的 Gln126–药物酰胺羰基氢键；此处报告 N···O 重原子距离。
explanation.en: Gln126–ligand amide-carbonyl hydrogen bond assigned in Figure 6 of the original study; the value is the N···O heavy-atom distance.

6TOT-A.receptorAltlocPolicy: common atoms plus alt A, if present
